name: Coefficient Space of the Union-Closed Digraph Construction
proof: The full coefficient criterion is $A_vP_e+B_vQ_e>1>A_wP_e+B_wQ_e$ on every arc. Each feedback halfplane intersection has a continuous rational center and radial Euclidean fiber. Logarithmic vertex coordinates give $\mathcal Z(G)$, and the cycle-arrangement product gives $B_G$.
